text:
alex (AE): Quick sync — Prospect 'MeridianPay' needs SSO (SAML), SCIM bulk + PATCH, RBAC mapping, delegated domain verification, and an on-prem connector for their HSM. Need tech + pricing notes.

mira (SE): SCIM load? SP vs IdP? PATCH/delta required?

alex (AE): ~30k users, bursts to 300/min. SP preferred, will support IdP for partners. PATCH & deltas required.

ori (Solutions): For that scale recommend Dedicated or Hosted+burst credits. SCIM bursts drive request tiers — will produce cost scenarios.

tess (Security): They require customer-managed KMS, mTLS for connector, and audit log export to their SIEM. Confirm support for key rotation and per-request audit diffs.

mira (SE): RBAC: we map SCIM groups to roles; nested groups flatten — note if they need hierarchical enforcement. Domain proofing: we support TXT, file-based proof, and delegated OAuth for supported DNS.

alex (AE): Can Hosted use their KMS?

ori (Solutions): Yes if KMS reachable from our region. Air-gapped HSM => Private deployment required.

mira (SE): Sample SCIM PATCH for staging: curl -X PATCH https://staging-api.redwood.dev/scim/v2/Users/{id} -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"name.familyName","value":"Lopez"}]}'

tess (Security): I've uploaded the draft questionnaire. presales-bot: security questionnaire uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/compliance/meridian-qna (id ac12).

presales-bot: Next: legal review of redacted SOC2 and DPA addendum.

alex (AE): Action items — ori pricing by EOD, tess confirm KMS matrix, mira assemble POC checklist. I'll book a 30m call with Meridian.
